source.offset: Harmonized BOA offsets already applied; raw DN times 1e-4

rules.rgb: Display-referred sRGB from actual B04/B03/B02, 2x exposure (not a sharpened image), 10m, use low frequency only on broad land. Preserve stock high-res, native terrain, fall/creek, snow, glacier/ice and rendered water.
rules.material: class 0 preserve stock; 1 vegetated; 2 nonveg; 3 water; 4 snow/ice; source scene SCL plus valid bands, no category calls from index alone. SCL is 20m sampled to 10m.
rules.ndsi: (B03-B11)/(B03+B11), identical algebra to MNDWI and not sufficient to separate snow/water. Raw signed int8 scale 1/120; -128 invalid. SWIR 20m nearest repeated, not actual 10m spectral detail.
rules.sourceLimits: Single date 2025-09-04; not survey or real-time terrain. Preserve authored shore/ice unless concurrent geometric dataset verifies shape. No full newer ortho / replacement DEM integrated.

terrainPolicy: Only qualified inland crop; at disagreements and padding use stock.

terrain.vertical: NAVD88 minus established 18 m Aerie reference; no fitted shift.

source.rowOrder: north to south; columns west to east
source.vertical: NAVD88 (source vertical EPSG:5703), meters. subtract existing game lake datum 18m to compare; validate stable pins before blend. No vertical shift in GDAL, horizontal-only reprojection.
source.outputResampling: bounded GDAL window; bilinear to 1m, centimetre quantization
source.collection: USGS Southeast Alaska Landslides D22 Work Unit 2 July–Oct 2023 bare earth
source.limits: Distinct inland footprint, not new epoch, not the current creek/falls/cove patches. Actual stock difference and deposit/checkpoint accuracy require stable dry-world readback. Preserve game water and ice, do not alter collision without generated geometry and trajectory checks.

terrain.rule: Same measured terrain in ground and clearance. 18m edge feather; residual magnitudes above 1.7m fade out completely by 3.2m. Original water/ice/high-resolution features are outside this validated crop.
